lines.text: Cuffed at the wrist, twenty-four-year-old night-shift nurse Harper stares through the iron bars as officer footfalls echo down the hall.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Sign these divorce papers for my broke mechanic brother, Harper, and my legal team gets you out today.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: I promised Cole one year when he paid for Mia's heart surgery, Jake, and I don't break contracts.
Secretly disguised Whitmore CEO Cole enters with Boston's top defense attorney, slamming a digital audit report onto the table.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Drop the charges, because the hospital IP address that forged Harper's login belongs to Diane's office laptop.

scenes.heading: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - CORRIDOR - DAY

lines.text: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - CORRIDOR - DAY
Seventeen-year-old Mia adjusts the sling on her injured left arm as she catches stepmother Diane whispering to an administrator.

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: If that eighty-one-year-old matriarch wakes up, Cole gets the entire shipping fortune and we get nothing.
Mia gasps, accidentally knocking over a metal chart tray that clatters across the linoleum floor.
Diane whips around with a menacing glare, grabbing Mia by her uninjured shoulder.
Released from custody, Harper rushes to eighty-one-year-old Evelyn's bedside to check the tampered IV line.
Jake steps into the doorway, blocking the exit while sliding a secret investigation file across the bedside table.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Ask your mechanic husband why his real name is on the Whitmore family trust fund, nurse Lane.
Suddenly, Evelyn's hand twitches, her fingers tightly locking around Harper's wrist as her heart monitor sounds a rapid alarm.
